title: The World's Shortest Flight Is Over in a Minute
hook: In Scotland, there's a regular flight that lands a minute after takeoff
summary: The flight between Westray and Papa Westray in the Orkney Islands covers 2.7 km and takes just over a minute.

text: The Orkney Islands, in the far north of Scotland.
There's a plane that links two small islands here.

panels.mean: the flight time on the timetable

text: but the actual time in the air is just over a minute.

panels.text: You'd be there by the time you buckle up

text: The fastest flight on record took 53 seconds.
The route has been flying since 1967,
and it's still the shortest scheduled passenger flight in the world.

panels.text: One minute on a plane and you're on another island
